report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with durations 78-230ms; gateway p95 ~230ms and payment p95 ~4.75ms show no error or saturation signal. No 5xx, no pool exhaustion, no Redis timeout, no deployment or memory facts. Current evidence does not establish any bounded root cause; operator hypothesis unconfirmed. Handing off for more evidence.
missing_evidence: Gateway logs (ev-...-gw-logs) were excluded; needed to confirm no errors or timeouts on checkout path.
No dependency-operation metrics for gateway or payment; cannot attribute latency to a specific downstream dependency.
No baseline latency distribution to judge whether 78-230ms checkout durations are anomalous.
